result.title: Triage-PiEvo: Evidence Admission for Principle-Evolving Scientific Agents
result.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based AI Scientists advance scientific discovery, yet they suffer from inefficiencies due to noisy observations. Existing principle-evolving agents act on every anomaly, leaving its source unresolved: a new mechanism or an evaluation artifact, so invalid revisions bias evolution. To address this, we formulate revision as evidence admission: anomalies steer search immediately, but only independently verified evidence may rewrite persistent principles, and contradicted principles are retracted. We realize this in TRIAGE-PIEVO , which pairs an anomaly-responsive search portfolio with a staged verification gate that alone controls what enters principle state. Across four scientific tasks with three backbones, TRIAGE-PIEVO (1) attains the highest average solution quality with +7.5%~11.8% over the strongest baseline per backbone, matching the strongest baseline's full-budget quality with one-third of the evaluation budget on Qwen3-235B; and additional stress tests and cross-harness deployment demonstrate that (2) in constructed stress tests, it admits none of the corrupted, hidden-source, or exploit evidence that ungated variants admit, while missing no planted mechanism, and (3) plugged unchanged into three external research harnesses, it cuts false evidence admissions by over 60% and raises verified scores by 31%~43%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把原理演化型科学智能体的修订过程重构为「证据准入」问题，提出 TRIAGE-PIEVO：异常驱动的搜索用于立即引导搜索方向，而只有经独立验证的证据才被允许改写持久原则，被矛盾的原则则被撤回。
AI.relevance_reason: 其分阶段验证门控与「准入—撤回」机制，可能为 LVR 中筛选进入推理状态的视觉证据、抑制噪声观察引发错误状态更新提供方法线索，可供核查其验证信号是否独立于被检验的假设。
